Application Fee Waivers
The Graduate School offers a limited number of application fee waivers to qualified applicants. Review the options below to determine whether you are eligible. Each waiver type has specific criteria and may require documentation.
After submitting your application, do not pay the application fee if you have requested an application fee waiver.
Deadline
Application fee waiver requests must be made at least seven (7) days before your program’s application deadline to allow time for review. Graduate Enrollment Management Services (GEMS) staff process requests in the order received.
Application submission steps vary by waiver type. See the Financial Need, McNair Scholar, and PPIA Fellow, and Stacked Graduate Degree sections below for details and exceptions. Failure to follow instructions outlined in the “How to request” section may delay processing.
qualifications
Financial Need Fee Waiver
Who is eligible?
Application fee waivers are available to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and undocumented applicants who demonstrate financial need or hardship. Eligibility is determined using the Washington College Grant Program, specifically using the 100% Median Family Income (MFI) threshold.
Reported income should reflect the most recent tax year
Washington state residency is not required
Supporting documentation is not required at the time of application, but may be requested if your application is selected for audit
Applicants who expect to hold or currently hold F-1 or J-1 visa status are not eligible for this fee waiver due to federal eligibility requirements.
How to request
Complete all required sections of the application.
Click on the “Submit Application” button at the bottom of the “Review” page.
You will be directed to your Applicant Status Portal. Click on the link labeled “Request an Application Fee Waiver”.
Complete the fee waiver eligibility questionnaire.
Select ‘Financial’ as your Application Fee Waiver type.
Indicate your annual income and family size.
IMPORTANT: Graduate Enrollment Management Services (GEMS) cannot waive or refund the application fee once it has been paid.
McNair and PPIA Fellows
Currently, two graduate preparation programs qualify for an application fee waiver.
McNair Scholars
Public Policy and International Affairs (PPIA)
Who is eligible?
Application fee waivers are available to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and undocumented applicants who are current or former participants in approved graduate preparation programs (e.g., McNair Scholars Program, PPIA Fellows Program).
Applicants who expect to hold or currently hold F-1 or J-1 visa status are not eligible for these fee waivers due to federal eligibility requirements.
How to request
Begin your application and complete the Profile Information section of the Graduate School application.
At the bottom of that section, select “Yes” in response to: “Are you a current McNair Scholar or PPIA Fellow and would like to request an application fee waiver?”
Upload your supporting documentation when prompted.
PPIA Fellows must complete all application information and submit the application. McNair Scholars may continue working on their application and submit it later, as long as it is submitted by the program’s application deadline. uploading your documentation, complete all application information and submit your application.
IMPORTANT: Graduate Enrollment Management Services (GEMS) cannot waive or refund the application fee once it has been paid.
Supporting Documentation
GEMS will not process a fee waiver request without the submission of supporting documentation in the application or Application Status Portal.
McNair Scholars should fill out the McNair Verification Form with their director.
Access the McNair Verification Form here.
The documentation or letter must include the following:
Applicant’s first and last name as self-reported on their UW application.
The participating institution self-reported on their UW application.
Name of the program in which they participated.
Note: Previous participation must have been through the completion of the degree-seeking program
Dates of participation
The position and signature of the program director verifying current participation in the grant program.
Stacked Graduate Degree
This fee waiver is designed for applicants pursuing a stacked graduate degree and its required graduate certificates*. It ensures that eligible applicants pay only one application fee across programs that are part of the same approved stacked pathway. See Graduate School Policy 1.4: The Stacked Graduate Degree for more information.
This fee waiver is available to domestic and international applicants, including those applying for F-1 or J-1 visas.
*If you are unsure if a graduate program is part of a stacked degree, contact your intended program directly.
How the fee waiver works
If you apply for a stacked degree and required certificates in the same quarter, you will be charged only one application fee. Additional applications in that degree pathway will be automatically waived.
If you apply sequentially (in different quarters), you may request a fee waiver for subsequent applications.
Eligibility criteria (sequential applications only)
To qualify, you must:
Have previously applied to and enrolled in:
A stacked graduate degree, or
A required graduate certificate tied to that stacked degree
Have paid the application fee (or received an approved dee waiver, see additional waiver types above) for your initial application
Be applying to a program that is part of the same approved stacked degree pathway
Additional conditions
The graduate certificate must be a required component of the stacked degree
There is no time limit between applications (continuous enrollment is not required)
A maximum of three fee waivers is allowed per applicant, per stacked degree
If you begin in a different stacked degree, the limit is reset (a new application fee is required)
How to request
Begin your application by selecting the appropriate stacked graduate degree or graduate certificates.
Complete all required sections of the application
You must select “Yes” in response to: “Are you or have you ever been enrolled in a stackable graduate certificate that is part of the following stacked degree?” and then select the appropriate stacked graduate degree or graduate certificates.
Click on the “Submit Application” button at the bottom of the “Review” page.
You will be directed to your Applicant Status Portal. Do not pay the application fee.
Important
GEMS will review your request within 1-2 business days, excluding the University of Washington holidays. Please check your email for status updates and follow any instructions provided in the email.
If you receive approval but your payment status still shows pending, please notify GEMS as soon as possible to report the discrepancy. Prompt reporting helps ensure your application is processed correctly.
Participating in AmeriCorps, veteran status, and other state or federal grant programs are not currently approved. Please check with your intended program, as they may pay your application fee on behalf of their department.
